caption:
She wasn't running bad because she forgot how to run.

Her owner had tried a new bit, a new saddle pad, a new warm-up routine. The times stayed flat. Then Dr. Leo came out, found restriction through her mid-back, and worked through it.

Next run, she ran like she had something to prove.

Sometimes the answer isn't in the equipment. It's in the horse.

If your mare is showing up to the pen but not leaving everything in it, she may just need someone to check what's going on underneath the saddle — not what's sitting on top of it.

We're seeing horses across DFW and North Texas. DM 'BOOK' to grab a spot with Dr. Leo.

Late summer is the season most people skip the checkup.

Spring got busy. Summer got busier. And now you're deep in the run season with a horse that's been hauled, pushed, and asked to perform on hard ground since March.

Dr. Leo is out seeing horses across DFW and North Texas. Not because something's wrong — because four months of work deserves a look before the fall push begins.

If your horse is moving fine, great. We'll confirm that and you'll have peace of mind going into the back half of the year. If something's off, you'd rather find it now than in the middle of your next run.

Book now — shortgochiro.com or call (406) 799-3369.
